title: What Nephi Records
summary: Nephi states that he does not give his fathers’ genealogy on these plates, because it is in the record kept by his father. He says that they are descendants of Joseph.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi does not give his fathers’ genealogy in this part of his record and will not give it later on these plates; it is in the record kept by his father.
Nephi says that they are descendants of Joseph.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi may be depicted writing his record.
unspecified_visual_details: Nephi’s appearance, surroundings, writing materials, and the physical form of his father’s record are unspecified.

narration.text: And now I, Nephi, do not give the genealogy of my fathers in this part of my record;
For it sufficeth me to say that we are descendants of Joseph.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Nephi distinguishes the record on these plates from the record kept by his father.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Joseph or Nephi’s father as present; they are mentioned, not shown.

title: Room for the Things of God
summary: Nephi explains that he does not give a full account of his father's things because they cannot be written upon the plates, and he desires room to write of the things of God. He states his intent to persuade people to come unto God and be saved.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi says it does not matter to him to give a full account of all the things of his father, because they cannot be written upon the plates; he desires room to write of the things of God.
Nephi says his intent is to persuade people to come unto the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, and be saved.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi may be shown writing on plates, as the passage refers to writing upon plates.
unspecified_visual_details: Nephi's appearance, precise location, surroundings, writing implements, and whether he is writing at this moment are not specified.

narration.text: I desire the room that I may write of the things of God.
For the fulness of mine intent is that I may persuade men to come unto the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, and be saved.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Nephi states an intent to persuade people to come unto God and be saved.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict God or the named patriarchs as visibly present; the verses do not describe their appearance or presence.

title: Things of Worth
summary: Nephi says he does not write things pleasing to the world, but things pleasing to God and those who are not of the world. He says he will give his seed a commandment not to occupy the plates with things not of worth to the children of men.

explicit_facts.text: Nephi says he does not write things pleasing to the world, but writes things pleasing to God and to those who are not of the world.
Nephi says he shall give commandment to his seed that they shall not occupy the plates with things that are not of worth to the children of men.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi may be shown writing on plates, but the text does not explicitly describe him doing so in this moment.
unspecified_visual_details: Nephi's appearance, surroundings, writing implements, and the identity or appearance of his seed are not specified.

I shall give commandment unto my seed

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Nephi states what he chooses to write and a future instruction for his seed.
